notes.title: Minor patch released
notes.content: Fixed a reported bug concerning AI having empty fleets in some rare case, by introducing a empty fleet check on turn end and dismantling of such fleets. Also added a more detailed crash log generation.

notes.title: Minor patch released
notes.content: Patch 1.0.1 has been released today, it addresses the two CTDs reported by a few people, the right click menu and end of turn refresh bugs. I couldn't reproduce the errors, so the code should detect when these two exceptions are raised and handles them gracefully instead of crashing to the desktop.
